visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing black-rimmed glasses and a yellow button-down shirt over a white tee holds a brown Kiehl's bottle against a plain white wall. He gestures with his hands while looking off-camera. The scene cuts to him holding two black Kiehl's gift bags in a close-up, looking directly at the lens with a slightly exaggerated expression. (2) The man is shown pouring a liquid from a clear Kiehl's bottle onto his palm while wearing sunglasses on top of his head. He then dabs a cotton pad on his cheek. The lighting is bright and even. The scene shifts to a close-up of a Kiehl's Calendula toner bottle with a shimmering graphic effect surrounding it. (3) The character is seen aggressively typing on a large electronic calculator while holding the toner bottle, portraying a 'strategic' shopper. He wears a yellow shirt and black pinstripe trousers. The camera angle is slightly low, looking up at him as he calculates. (4) A transition occurs where the man wears a plush yellow sunflower headpiece, representing a 'persuading angel.' He holds up various Kiehl's samples and a black tote bag. The background is simple, and he smiles warmly at the camera. (5) The scene shifts to a 'tempting devil' persona where he is seen in a darkened environment, looking slightly mischievous while holding a black bag. Then, he is back in his normal yellow shirt, throwing a black credit card towards the camera with a confident grin. (6) He portrays a beauty consultant with a long brown wig, glasses, and a professional uniform. He gestures towards a Kiehl's bottle and points his finger emphatically. The background is a blurred image of a luxurious shopping mall interior. (7) A close-up shows the man applying a wet cotton pad to his cheek, demonstrating product use. His skin looks clear and moisturized. He smiles and points to the product bottle held next to his face. (8) The consultant character returns, holding a small sample bottle and a flyer, explaining a promotional offer. He gestures animatedly with his hands. A hand from off-screen presents a tray full of various Kiehl's skincare products. (9) The man is seen in his original yellow shirt, looking surprised and excited as he holds a wooden tray of products. He points to the camera. The final shot shows the consultant character again, holding a calculator and a flyer, looking directly at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo pop electronic background music track begins immediately with a strong, rhythmic beat. A male voice speaks with high arousal and a friendly, energetic tone, introducing the topic of department store shoppers. The speech rate is fast and enthusiastic. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. The music continues as the speaker's tone becomes more exaggerated and dramatic. There is a clear percussive 'clink' sound as the Kiehl's bottle is handled. The vocal pitch is moderately high. (3) A series of mechanical 'click' and 'tap' sounds from a calculator are heard, synchronized with the visual action of the man typing. The BGM remains constant. The speaker uses an analytical yet excited tone, describing discounts and deals with fast articulation. (4) The vocal delivery shifts to a higher-pitched, airy, and 'angelic' quality as the character puts on the sunflower headpiece. The music swells slightly in volume. Short, shimmering digital sound effects accompany the presentation of product samples. The intensity of speech remains moderate but very expressive. (5) A low-pitched, slightly distorted vocal effect is briefly heard for the 'devil' persona. The BGM beat becomes more prominent. A sharp 'snap' sound occurs as a credit card is flicked toward the camera. The speaker's volume increases as he mentions a final total. (6) A hard cut in the audio leads to a new vocal persona: a professional beauty consultant with a sharp, authoritative, yet friendly tone. The music stays in the background as a steady rhythmic bed. The speaker's pitch variability is high as she explains skin types. (7) A soft 'dabbing' sound or subtle liquid rustle can be heard during the product application scenes. The BGM tempo remains consistent at around 128 BPM. The speaker continues with high-density information about product benefits and specific ingredients like peptides. (8) Multiple 'ding' sound effects play as specific offers and free gifts are highlighted on screen. The background music maintains its energetic, driving feel. The speaker's voice shows high dominance and confidence as he pitches the sale. (9) The audio ends with a high-energy shout-out catchphrase. The music reaches a final crescendo and then stops abruptly with a clean cut. The final speech segment is extremely fast-paced, encouraging viewers to take advantage of the百貨預購會 pre-sale.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Scenario 1 -> Scenario 2 -> Scenario 3 -> Brand Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous sketch format to role-play three types of department store shoppers to promote Kiehl's pre-sale event. By contrasting different consumer behaviors (Strategic, Gift-Chasing, and Uninformed) and providing the 'Strongest Consultant' as a solution, it highlights the brand's discounts and product benefits to drive sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of Kiehl's products, mention of department store pre-sales, and specific price/gift information.
